name: FLUX 3 Image Klein
purpose: Open-weights 5.6B image editing, text-to-image and multi-reference composition (up to 10 images) with bounding-box layout guidance; distilled checkpoint for editing, generation and self-hosting; a separate Klein Base is for fine-tuning.

license.name: FLUX Kommunity License v1.0
license.notes: Text read in LICENSE.md of the unsloth GGUF repo (copy of the BFL file; the BFL repo is gated). 'Non-Commercial Purpose' covers personal, research and hobby use; commercial use only as 'Qualifying User' ("gross annualized revenue is less than US$5,000,000" together with affiliates), then with content filters or output review and AI disclosure; redistribution of weights and derivatives allowed with the license, an attribution notice and a modified-notice. Excluded: military, surveillance, biometric processing. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: diffusion transformer, dense, separate text encoder Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (Apache-2.0)

variants.notes: recommended by unsloth; Q4_K_M 3.67, Q5_K_M 4.22, Q6_K 4.80, Q8_0 6.09, UD-Q2_K_XL 2.62, BF16 11.10 GB; text encoder Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and VAE separate

pc-16gb.notes: No seconds-per-image figure for RDNA3 or RDNA4 (or any AMD card) for this model found in web searches on 2026-11-19.

weaknesses: license limits commercial use of outputs for larger companies

user_reports.summary: Launch-day community tests compared it with Krea 2, Qwen-Image 2.1 and FLUX.2 klein and pointed to anatomy errors and artifacts; one editing test found collateral changes beyond the requested edit; reviews are mostly launch-period SEO pages.

tona_fit.reason: Newest BFL klein (5.6B, 16 steps, generation plus editing, multi-reference). Independent quality tests are still thin, so compare with z-image-turbo and qwen-image-2.1-turbo on our own prompts before choosing the default.
